about_the_game:
Jeijei's Harem - A New Home is an adult dating sim featuring:

  • interesting story with choices

  • animated sex scenes with moans and moving camera

  • 6 dateable characters + 2 side characters the main character can have vaginal sex with

  • minigames (optional)

  • timeslot and resource management (optional)

The game has two game modes. In full game mode the player has full control over where and when he does things. In other words, the game is like a sandbox where all the player's actions (like training at gym or spending time with a girl) cost one timeslot. In story mode, on the other hand, the game is like a visual novel without any timeslot management or free roaming.

In the beginning of the game, the main character's home is attacked and he barely survives the attack. Since his life is still in danger, he is forced to leave everything behind and move to a small community living in the middle of nowhere. As the only son of the community's leader, he is popular among women and has a lot of power, but also a lot of responsibility. Professional killers are still after him, so in order to be able to fight them back in the future, he begins military training.
